inventory.detail: Client GA4 support exists through a consent-gated evidence tracker.
Server Data API dependency exists but is classified as external evidence.
Analytics source hierarchy keeps first-party event facts and rollups as product truth.

fixesApplied.detail: Added shared GA4 truth and cost-guard helper.
Admin historical analytics records GA4 evidence state without blocking first-party fallback.

adminIntegrationFindings.detail: Missing GA4 config no longer blocks the historical admin analytics route.
Missing GA4 evidence is displayed as unavailable and never as zero traffic.
Admin historical analytics keeps first-party sources canonical and GA4 as external evidence.

clientIntegrationFindings.detail: Client GA4 cannot load without a public measurement ID.
Client GA4 respects the existing analytics consent gate.
Root layout mounts the GA4 evidence tracker once without replacing first-party DeepTracker.

costFindings.detail: Default admin analytics load does not call GA4 Data API.
GA4 evidence refresh requires explicit refresh and respects the retry TTL.

recoveryTimelineFindings.detail: GA4 evidence states classify config_missing, unavailable, evidence_only, imported_sample, and stale without producing product truth.
Known GA4 event names map into recovery timeline evidence entries with source labels.
GA4 commerce/GumDrop evidence is rejected from product truth without first-party ledger corroboration.

prCleanupActions: No open GA4, analytics, PostHog, admin analytics, script/env PRs found at start.
nextFixOrder: If owner-approved GA4 evidence is needed, add measurement/property configuration and run only explicit refreshes.
Keep first-party analytics event facts and rollups as product truth for admin totals.
Use GA4 snapshots as external comparison evidence, not live totals.
